subject: cult-af-bs
title: CULT.AF.BS.------INFO.DY.
description: Second diagram on page 387, paired with C-CULT-AT × RT-DY above: CULT-AF-BS (culture affinity basis) is crossed with INFO-DY (information dynamics — what touring/booking *as exposure* would do for the form). CULT-AF-BS is subject on the left with the subject-arrow, and its main line runs down-right to INFO-DY. Three lines leave the main line: a vertical drops to VT-PLT (vibrational platform), with SPT-PLT branching from it to the lower left and V-SY (value system) to the lower right; one rises up-right to MT-INFO (multi-information), with TR-INFO (trans-information) branching from it to the upper right and EXP-DY (expansion dynamics) branching in turn from TR-INFO; and a second vertical drops to WO-EXP-PRI (world expansion principle), with COS-AGN (cosmic assignment) branching from it to the lower right.
